QuestInfo.name: [Rose Garden] Fresh Roses
QuestInfo.0: Talk to Cecilia about her first request.
QuestInfo.1: Cecilia says you can get Rose Seeds from defeating Frozen Roses. Click on empty flower pots with the seeds in your inventory to grow and collect roses. Collect #b5 Roses#k and then return to Cecilia.
QuestInfo.2: You gathered 5 Roses and returned to Cecilia.

0.0: All right. Could you do something for me before we start the jewelry hunt?
0.1: This place used to have the most lovely roses in the kingdom, but after the eternal winter set on...well, you can imagine what happened.
0.2: I haven't seen fresh roses in ages. Could you grow some? Defeat #bFrozen Roses#k to get #bRose Seeds#k and then #bclick empty flower pots#k with them in your inventory to grow the Roses. Can you do that for me?

yes.0: I'm sure it'll be easy. #eClick the flower pot, collect 5 Roses, and come talk to me.#n\r\n#b (Go to the Abandoned Garden.)#k

no.0: Did I mention there are rewards? Because I have rewards. For you. Lots of them.

1.0: Oh, my. Fresh roses... I remember this feeling. It reminds me of...being alive. That's kind of a bummer, actually.\r\n

yes.0: Ugh, I need to stop being such a downer. Here, let me show you something I used to make...
